---
title: "Reproducibility and Experimental Validation"
---

## Protocol

The validation gate checks the RStudio project, dependency manifest, review protocol, screening criteria, bundled example input, numbered pipeline stages, automated tests, and manuscript. GitHub Actions repeats these checks on supported R versions.

## Recorded evidence

`experiments/run_validation.R` produces:

- `artifacts/validation/structural_validation.csv`, with one Boolean result per check;
- `artifacts/validation/session_summary.txt`, with R version, platform, UTC timestamp, and pass count;
- `logs/pipeline_runs.csv`, with step status, start time, duration, and error details.

These artifacts connect the documented method to an executable software state. They do not by themselves validate substantive review conclusions, which require domain-specific evaluation and independent replication.
